findings: Combine: with two PDFs listed, the card's own Combine button is not visible without scrolling at this size. Its bottom would be at y 778, and the canvas ends at y 693, so it is 85 points short. One scroll (109 points) shows it (wide/06a-combine-end.png). Each further PDF adds about 114 points.
Home: the cards' third caption line (when the PDF was last opened, here 'Not opened yet') sits at the fold: 2 of its 18 points show.

Both come from height: keeping the window above the dock costs 78 points on this 898-point-tall window. Before that change the startup window's app area was 740 points tall: Home's captions fitted, and the Combine button was about 7 points short.
